name: train_spec_volibear
description: Dispatch marker for the Volibear specialist (riftlab.yml, request=lab/specs/train_spec_volibear.json, chain=N). From its next start it trains with the method proven on Riven (lab/learn/TRAINING_KNOWLEDGE.md): continuous, one candidate per iteration from 1600 self-play games (15% mirror, the rest against loop.SPECIALISTS['volibear']['train'] by their share of the Stuttgart field, the Riven lists piloted by the Riven specialist's committed net), adopted unless clearly worse; progress on four frozen anchors and the held-out 'measure' opponents. Ladder lab/learn/specialists/volibear/ladder.json.
